orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
CRLR No. 249 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Narendra Bali, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
 Mr. Sandeep Tandon, Dy. A.G. with Ms. 
Shivangi Gangwar, Brief Holder for the State. 
 Heard. 
 Admit. 
 Issue notice to the respondent no.2 fixing 
25.06.2019. 
 Steps be taken within a week. 
 Heard on stay application no. 1190 of 2019. 
 As an interim measure, it is directed that till 
the next date of listing, the effect and operation of 
impugned order dated 28.03.2019 shall remain 
stayed provided revisionist pays a sum of 
Rs.10,000/- per month to the respondent-wife. 
The amount of maintenance shall be paid by 7th 
of every month. 
 Stay application stands disposed of 
accordingly. 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 15.05.2019 Mamta

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CRLR No. 249 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Narendra Bali, Advocate for the 
revisionist.
Mr. P.S. Bohra, AGA along with Mr. 
Siddharth Bisht, Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
In pursuance to the steps taken by the 
revisionist on 20.05.2019, it is reported by the 
Registry that the learned CJM, Haridwar has 
served respondent No. 2 through her mother.
Since the said report of service happens to 
be of 24.06.2019 itself, in the interest of justice, 
the matter is adjourned for two weeks, so as to 
enable to respondent to respond to the notice, 
which has already been served on her on 
24.06.2019.
Put up this matter after two weeks.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 25.06.2019
Mahinder/
